AUTTAINE SORCERER/LOREMASTER/ARCHMAGE
CR 18/MR 1

XP 204,800
Auttaine sorcerer 13/loremaster 5/archmage 1
LN Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +7; Senses Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 14, flat-footed 20 (+4 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)
hp 190 (18d6+105); fast-healing 5
Fort +16, Ref +17, Will +22; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Defensive Abilities fated (+3), hard to kill; Resist construct resistances

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Ranged mindrender +11/+6 (1 negative level plus staggered)
Special Attacks breath weapon, 20-ft. line (DC 19), it was meant to be 1/day, mythic power (5/day, surge +1d6)
Bloodline Spell-Like Abilities (CL 18th; concentration +24)

9/day—touch of destiny (+6)

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 18th; concentration +24)

9th (3/day)—wail of the banshee (DC 27)
8th (5/day)—horrid wilting (DC 26), iron body
7th (6/day)—finger of death M (DC 25), hungry darkness, insanity (DC 23)
6th (7/day)—chain lightning (DC 22), flesh to ooze (DC 22), mislead (DC 22), summon monster VI
5th (7/day)—break enchantment, interposing hand, mage’s faithful hound, mass pain strike (DC 21), wreath of blades (DC 21)
4th (7/day)—arcane eye, ball lightning (DC 20), black tentacles, contagion (DC 22), freedom of movement
3rd (7/day)—clairaudience/clairvoyance, fireball (DC 19), fly, haste, protection from energy
2nd (8/day)—anticipate thoughts (DC 18), blur, detect thoughts (DC 18), fire breath (DC 18), invisibility, mirror image
1st (8/day)—alarm, chill touch (DC 19), detect charm, detect radiation, magic missile, obscuring mist
0 (at will)—acid splash, detect magic, detect poison, ghost sound (DC 16), mage hand, mending, read magic, touch of fatigue (DC 18), vacuous vessel (DC 16)

Bloodline Destined M Mythic spell

STATISTICS

Str 7, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 18, Wis 21, Cha 22
Base Atk +8; CMB +6; CMD 20
Feats Craft Wand, Eschew Materials, Great Fortitude, Improved Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Lightning Reflexes, Maximize Spell, Scribe Scroll, Skill Focus (Knowledge [arcana]), Spell Focus (necromancy)M, Toughness M Mythic feat
Skills Appraise +12, Knowledge (arcana) +33, Knowledge (history) +27, Linguistics +25, Perception +23, Sense Motive +10, Spellcraft +25
Languages Common, Draconic, Giant, Gnome, Undercommon
SQ bloodline arcana (gains a luck bonus on saves when casting personal-range spells), construction points (3-natural armor (1), breath weapon), lore, mage strike, mythic spellcasting, secrets (dodge trick, knowledge of avoidance, secrets of inner strength)
Gear potion of cure serious wounds (2), scroll of interplanetary teleport, staff of acid, wand of dispel magic with 10 charges; Other Gear mindrender, amulet of natural armor +5, belt of mighty constitution +6, bracers of armor +4, cloak of resistance +4, long coat made of cured choker skin, high leather boots of speed, Purity medal of honor made of platinum and gold in worth 3,200 gp, Purity commander uniform, battered leather journal containing Roth’s lifelong studies of the Ancients, and Asteroid 113 in particular, an Ancients’ collection of curious jade and skymetal figures depicting the very animals the PCs have seen on the gates here; the figures clearly make up some sort of Ancients’ game and are worth 1,400 gp.

>SPECIAL ABILITIES

Nanite Surge (Ex)

This NPC can trigger a nanite surge as a swift action, giving him fast healing 5. This healing can only restore up to a number equal to his maximum hit points per day and cannot exceed his maximum hit point total—all excess healing is lost. Roth can suppress the nanite surge as a free action.
